title: Cozy Cottage in the Heart of Cool Springs.
description:
Charming cottage home nestled on one acre in the heart of Cool Springs.  This home has 2 beds, 2 baths, and a double deck to for the outdoor bbq. 
Many guests have enjoyed using the fire pit outside and were delighted in spotting the turkeys and deer that are living in areas nearby. 
The Cozy cottage is Conveniently located minutes from grocery stores, coffee shops and restaurants.  It is  located 1.5 miles from I-65 and 5 Miles to historic downtown Franklin and 25 miles to downtown Nashville."

Other things to note
